Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in human assays against the human CB1 receptor (CHEMBL218). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL218 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Inner join compound_structures to require canonical SMILES. Return columns named compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
